display_mode.name: LostHumansGeneral
display_mode.tooltip:
Shows any active 失落人类s on the galaxy map as well as any unique structures spawned by 失落人类 activity, such as Firewalls. (Shows only the first Icon of each type on a planet, aka, 5 旅行者 on a single player would be covered as a singular Icon.)
Shows a Green Line showing the current 建造护航队 path, if it exists.
